output.reason: The brief backs its claim with specific evidence: blocks and failures start in the same minute, failures hit every app and OS version equally, and only password logins are affected. That explains everything I've seen better than the 6.14 theory, and it gives a clear, low-risk fix. One gap: it doesn't say why failures on versions older than 6.14 (which use the older nettle-http 4.11) would also be blocked.
